goal: Review financing, apply for the best option, then disburse in the sandbox.

factors.label: Revenue stability
factors.explanation: Monthly revenue varies by 24% (lower is steadier).

factors.label: Operating margin
factors.explanation: Operating margin is -22% before loan repayments and owner draws.

factors.label: Customer spread
factors.explanation: Largest named customer is 2% of named sales.

factors.label: Repayment discipline
factors.explanation: Repayments recorded in 10 of 12 months since the first one.

improve: Review supplier prices and low-margin lines to widen your operating margin.
Keep operating cash well above loan repayments before taking new debt.

alerts.msg: Cash goes negative in the week of 2026-10-05 even in the base case.
If sales are 20% weaker, cash could fall to ₦-3,732,173 in the week of 2026-12-14, below your two-week buffer of ₦1,969,428.
